clue.text: Skill shown by Constable initially, painting light vehicle

parts.note: a hand at something is a skill or knack, as in being a dab hand

indicators.note: initially asks for only the opening letter of the word Constable

parts.note: painting is art

explanation.surface: Constable's skill shows from the start of a painting of a light cart.
explanation.walkthrough: Constable looks like the painter, fitting 'painting', but only his initial C is used.
explanation.definitionFit: A hand-pushed cart is a small, light vehicle with wheels.

clue.text: Kid supplied by poet with writing material

parts.note: Thomas Hood was an English poet
ink is a material used for writing

explanation.surface: A child given ink by a poet.
explanation.definitionFit: To kid someone is to deceive or fool them.

clue.text: Curiosity about one's racket

indicators.note: about means the curiosity word goes around the letter for one

parts.note: nosiness is prying curiosity
one is I, the Roman numeral; the 's is the link 'is'

explanation.surface: Curiosity about someone's shady business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'racket' looks like a scam but is the definition, meaning din.
explanation.definitionFit: A racket is a loud din or clamour.

clue.text: One fabric or another used in church

indicators.note: used in means the second fabric is put inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
rep is another fabric, a ribbed cloth

explanation.surface: Materials of one kind or another used in a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin crinkled cloth is a type of material.

clue.text: Restoration of one organ we erected inside

indicators.note: inside places the upturned word within the kidney adjective

parts.note: renal means of the kidneys

indicators.note: erected in a down clue means the word is set upright, so read from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Restoring a church organ we have installed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organ' suggests the church instrument; it is the kidney. 'erected' sets WE upright, giving EW.
explanation.definitionFit: A renewal brings something back to a fresh condition.

clue.text: A couple of points covered by the present dissertation

indicators.note: covered by puts the points inside the word for the present, which wraps round them

parts.note: the present, as in this day or this moment, gives this
two compass points, East and South

explanation.surface: A dissertation on two points currently under discussion.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctoral candidate writes a long academic treatise of this kind.

clue.text: Plumed hat, possibly, produced by ambassador before speech

parts.note: HE, His Excellency, is the title of an ambassador
an address is a formal speech

explanation.surface: An ambassador gives a speech wearing a feathered hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A plumed hat is one example of headwear, hence 'possibly'.

clue.text: Alter a dress

definitions.meaning: to alter is to change or move

explanation.definitionFit: Both a change and a loose straight dress.

clue.text: Yacht rounding cape followed by the cutter

indicators.note: rounding means the yacht abbreviation goes around the cape letter

parts.note: SY is the abbreviation for steam yacht
C is the map abbreviation for cape
taken as written

explanation.surface: A yacht sails round the headland with a cutter behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutter' suggests a boat, fitting the yacht, but means a mowing blade.
explanation.definitionFit: A long curved blade for mowing grass is a cutting tool.

clue.text: Possibly collect article held by busybody

indicators.note: held by puts the article inside the word for a busybody

parts.note: a pryer is a nosy person
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A busybody perhaps collecting items.
explanation.walkthrough: A collect is a short church prayer; 'Possibly' marks it as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: A collect is a short liturgical petition, one kind of devotion.

clue.text: Girl recognized as musical right away

indicators.note: right away tells us the abbreviation for right is taken out of the musical

parts.note: Oliver! is Lionel Bart's musical based on Oliver Twist

explanation.surface: A girl spotted straight away as being musical.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right away' reads as 'immediately' but means remove R.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's given name, borrowed from the tree of the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Boy seized in atrocity out East? It's not unusual

indicators.note: seized in means the boy's name is held inside the other piece
out tells us the abbreviation for East leaves the word for atrocity

parts.note: an enormity is a monstrous crime or atrocity
Al is a boy's name, short for Alan or Albert

explanation.surface: A boy caught up in some atrocity in the Far East, which sadly is common.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' leaves NORMITY, which 'seized in' wraps round the boy. The definition is a whole phrase standing for a state of affairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Normality is the condition of being ordinary, so something with that quality is commonplace.

clue.text: Pass idly during absence on holiday

parts.note: while means during the time that
someone absent on holiday is away

explanation.surface: Idling the time during an absence on vacation.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass time idly is to spend it lazily in a pleasant way.

clue.text: A wife like Queen Wilhelmina

definitions.meaning: in cockney slang 'my old ...' is one's wife
Wilhelmina was Queen of the Netherlands, so of that nationality

explanation.walkthrough: 'Old dutch' for a wife is cockney London slang, from 'duchess'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cockney slang for a spouse, and the nationality of the Netherlands' queen.

clue.text: Money from fund Lee misused

indicators.note: misused suggests the letters of the two words are put to the wrong use, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Lee has been misusing money from the fund.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The needful' is British slang for money.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, the necessary cash for something is called this, as in 'do the needful'.

clue.text: Stuffing many in army consume

indicators.note: in means the letter for many goes inside the joined army and consume words

parts.note: an army is a fighting force
to consume is to eat
M, Roman for a thousand, is many

explanation.surface: Lots of soldiers eat stuffing.
explanation.definitionFit: Seasoned chopped meat is used as a filling for poultry.

clue.text: In three choruses, repeat sound twice?

indicators.note: In tells us the letters sit inside the words three choruses

explanation.surface: Three choruses that echo a refrain over again.
explanation.definitionFit: An echo repeats a sound; doing so again repeats it a second time, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Retreat for art lovers in St. Petersburg

definitions.text: for art lovers in St. Petersburg
definitions.meaning: the great art museum in St Petersburg

explanation.definitionFit: Both a hermit's refuge and the famous Russian museum.

clue.text: Young person's support, of course, uplifted tragic princess

parts.note: a tee supports the ball on a golf course

indicators.note: uplifted in a down clue means the name is turned upwards, so read backwards

parts.note: Regan is a daughter of King Lear in Shakespeare's tragedy

explanation.surface: A young girl's golfing support raises a tragic princess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of course' is a golf course. 'uplifted' turns REGAN into NAGER. The 's on 'person's' reads as 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone aged thirteen to nineteen is a youth.

clue.text: Moneylender quietly abandoned by one seizing power

indicators.note: abandoned by means the letter for quietly is dropped from the word for the power-seizer

parts.note: a usurper seizes power or a throne illegally
p (piano) is the musical marking for quietly

explanation.surface: A moneylender quietly deserted by someone grabbing power.
explanation.definitionFit: A usurer lends cash at exorbitant interest.

clue.text: Description of poker very recently received?

definitions.meaning: a fireplace poker left in the coals glows; also the garden plant 'poker'
news fresh off the press is described as very hot

explanation.definitionFit: Glowing hot metal, and news so new it is still hot.

clue.text: Book to keep for oneself

definitions.meaning: to book is to make a reservation in advance
to hold something back for one's own use

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses mean setting something aside in advance or keeping it back.

clue.text: Spread out charge, accepting rising assistance

indicators.note: accepting means the charge word takes the assistance word inside it

parts.note: a rate is a charge or price

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: aid is assistance

explanation.surface: Rising fees spread, though some help is accepted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' sets the assistance word upwards in this down clue, giving DIA.
explanation.definitionFit: To radiate is to emanate or spread outwards from a centre.

clue.text: Cricketer's son departs, becoming officer's attendant

indicators.note: departs means the letter for son leaves the cricketer word

parts.note: a batsman is a cricketer

explanation.surface: A cricketer's son leaves to become an army servant.
explanation.walkthrough: A BATMAN is a British officer's personal servant.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier assigned as an officer's personal servant.

clue.text: Bandy words in a Parisian street about midnight

indicators.note: about means the street word goes around the middle letter

parts.note: rue is French for street
the middle of the word night is its letter G

explanation.surface: Exchanging words in a Paris street around twelve at night.
explanation.definitionFit: To bandy words is to quarrel or dispute.

clue.text: Creature mostly spotted in East. trapped by man

indicators.note: trapped by means the abbreviation for East is caught inside the word for man

parts.note: a gent is a man

explanation.surface: An animal usually seen in the East, caught by a man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly spotted' reads as 'usually seen' but describes the animal's coat; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A genet is a small catlike mammal with a coat usually marked with spots.

clue.text: It's taken away-this is the logical conclusion

definitions.meaning: a subtraction, an amount removed from a total

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a subtraction and an inference reached by reasoning.

clue.text: Affliction makes us angry

definitions.meaning: a burden or trial one must bear

explanation.definitionFit: A burden to bear, and annoyed.

clue.text: Nominates new assembly for state

indicators.note: a new assembly puts the letters of Nominates together in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A new assembly nominates its members for the state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembly' looks like a legislature, fitting 'state', but it is part of the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Minnesota is a US state in the Upper Midwest.

clue.text: Primate briefly requiring a lot of fruit

indicators.note: a lot of means most but not all of the fruit word, losing its last letter

parts.note: an orange is a fruit

explanation.surface: A monkey that needs plenty of fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' belongs to the definition: the short form of the ape's full name.
explanation.definitionFit: Orang is a shortened name for the orang-utan, a great ape.

clue.text: Small number a gallery put on the staff

parts.note: no. is the short abbreviation for number
the Tate is a London art gallery

explanation.surface: A gallery takes on a few new employees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'staff' suggests employees but is the musical stave, on which notes are written.
explanation.definitionFit: To write music in notation is to set it down on the stave.

clue.text: Clothing bishops possibly curse

parts.note: bishops are chessmen, an example of men in chess
to curse is to swear

explanation.surface: Bishops' vestments may make one swear.
explanation.definitionFit: Garments for males are a category of apparel sold in shops.
